QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_9

question.text: As per SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, NPOs may issue ZCZP Instruments through which of the following channels?

answer.text: Public Issue to the public, or Private Issue to Social Impact Funds registered under SEBI (AIF) Regulations.
Public Issue only, open exclusively to retail investors above 18 years of age.
Private Issue only, restricted to Qualified Institutional Buyers.
Rights Issue to existing donors of the NPO, capped at 10% of prior-year receipts.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per pp.69-70 of the workbook, ZCZP instruments may be issued (a) to the public through a Public Issue, or (b) to Social Impact Funds registered under SEBI (AIF) Regulations through a Private Issue. The public issuance provisions apply mutatis mutandis to the private issuance to Social Impact Funds. The Trap: Option B wrongly excludes private placement to Social Impact Funds. Option C wrongly excludes retail and public participation. Option D invents a rights-issue route that does not exist in ICDR. Note: The two ICDR-permitted channels are Public Issue and Private Issue to SEBI-registered Social Impact Funds, as stated on pp.69-70.
